text.jp:
ああ、待たせたな。
特製ポーションを持ってきたぞ。
text.official_en: We have, and we’ve brought the special potions you need.
text.real_en: Yeah, sorry to keep you waiting. We brought the special potions.

text.jp:
あいつらの悲願ってのは世界を崩壊させることじゃない。
きっと何か……他に重要なことがあるんだって。
text.official_en: That their goal isn’t to destroy the world... There must be more to it—something more important to them.

text.jp: あなた方はもしやミシディアからの……？
text.official_en: Greetings. Have you come from Mysidia?

text.jp:
いいって。
それよりも病人に早くポーションを。
text.official_en: Don’t worry about it. First things first, give the sick their potions.

text.jp:
いや、なんでもない。
話は終わりじゃ、南西の古城へ行くぞ。
text.official_en: ’Tis nothing. If we are done here, let us head southwest to the old castle.
text.real_en: No, it's nothing. That's enough talk. Let's head to the old castle to the southwest.

text.jp: じゃ、ワシもお前と一緒に行くとしよう。
text.official_en: With that said, I suppose I shall accompany you henceforth.

text.jp:
そう言ってもらえると嬉しいのう。
もっとも、ワシがいたとて、
六盟傑に勝つのは簡単なことではないぞ。
text.official_en: A sentiment that warms my heart. Yet praise me as you might, defeating the Sworn Six will be no easy task, even with myself at your side.
text.real_en: I'm glad to hear it. Though even with my help, defeating the Sworn Six won't be easy.

text.jp:
そこにクリスタルがある。
案内するからついてくるんじゃ。
text.official_en: It so happens that that is where the Crystal is located. Come, I shall guide you there.

text.jp: それがわかっておるなら……。
text.official_en: If you realize this, then—

text.jp: それと対峙するだけの覚悟と信念がお前にあるか？
text.official_en: I ask you this: Have you the conviction and resolve to stand against them?

text.jp:
それに……。
常闇にはラスウェルの命を助けてもらった。
text.official_en: As for Umbra... Well, he saved Lasswell.
text.real_en: And... Veritas of the Dark saved Lasswell's life.

text.jp:
それも自己満足だって言われたら
もう返す言葉がないけどな。
text.official_en: If you still think that’s shortsighted, then I don’t know what else to say.
text.real_en: If you call that self-satisfaction, I don't have anything to say back.

text.jp:
ただ、勝つんじゃない。
信念でも六盟傑に勝つんだ。
text.official_en: Just stopping them won’t be enough. We need to do it in a way that doesn’t sacrifice our beliefs.
text.real_en: It's not enough to just defeat them. We have to surpass their convictions too.

text.jp: だから、なんとなくわかるんだ。
text.official_en: Which is why I have this feeling...

text.jp:
だから、俺は何も捨てないし、誰も犠牲にしない。
六盟傑とは違う覚悟で戦う。
text.official_en: So I’ll fight them with my own kind of resolve—and not at the expense of others.
text.real_en: That's why I won't abandon anything or sacrifice anyone. I'll fight with a different resolve from theirs.

text.jp:
だが、何度も言ったように
今こうしている間にも
六盟傑にクリスタルが壊されるかもしれん。
text.official_en: As I have repeatedly stated, the Sworn Six may have shattered the Crystal while you were playing the hero.
text.real_en: But as I've told you many times, the Sworn Six might destroy the Crystal even as we speak.

text.jp: でも、俺はダメだと思うんだ。
text.official_en: But it’s not right.

text.jp:
ならば、ワシも口を酸っぱくした甲斐があるわい。
若さに任せて突っ走るのもいいが、
立ち止まってじっくり考えることも大切じゃ。
text.official_en: Then our discourse was not in vain. Thin is the line between swift action and youthful impatience—’twould do you well to practice due deliberation.
text.real_en: Then all my scolding was worthwhile. It's fine to charge ahead with youthful energy, but it's important to stop and think things through, too.

text.jp:
なんと、そんなことまで。
何かお礼をしないと……。
text.official_en: Even more good news! How blessed we are... We must thank you somehow.
text.real_en: You even took care of that? We have to find some way to thank you...

text.jp:
ふっ……。
面白い男じゃな、お前は。
text.official_en: Hmph... I admit, you are an interesting man, Rain.
text.real_en: Hmph... You really are an interesting man.

text.jp: わかりました、ありがとうございます。
text.official_en: Of course. My thanks once again.

text.jp: サクラ、どうかしたのか？
text.official_en: Is everything okay, Sakura?

text.jp: サクラのお陰で俺もいろいろと考えることができたよ。
text.official_en: And you’re a wise person, Sakura. You made me reflect on a lot of things. Thanks.
text.real_en: Thanks to you, Sakura, I've had a lot to think about.

text.jp:
サクラの言う通り
大事より小事を取っているようじゃ
あいつらの覚悟には勝てないかもしれない。
text.official_en: Maybe you’re right. Maybe I can’t match their resolve when I choose to get caught up in small things.
text.real_en: Just as you said, Sakura, if I put small matters ahead of the greater one, I might not be able to match their resolve.

text.jp: サクラの魔法があれば、六盟傑にも勝てると思う。
text.official_en: With your magic at our side, I bet we can finally give the Sworn Six a run for their money.
text.real_en: With your magic, Sakura, I think we can defeat the Sworn Six.

text.jp:
レインよ。
確かにお前は病人を救った。
text.official_en: Rain, you may have saved those villagers, but...
text.real_en: Rain. You did save the sick villagers.

text.jp:
世界が崩壊すれば、ここの村人もみんな死ぬ。
お前がやったことは、無意味になるということじゃ。
text.official_en: If the world falls to ruin, all these villagers will surely perish—all your work here will have been for naught.

text.jp:
何もかも捨て去り、全てを犠牲にしてでも
六盟傑は悲願を遂げようとするだろう。
text.official_en: The Sworn Six will sacrifice and forsake all to achieve their long-sought goal.
text.real_en: The Sworn Six will pursue their long-cherished goal even if it means abandoning and sacrificing everything.

text.jp:
何もかも捨て去り、全てを犠牲にする……。
あいつらと同じような覚悟で戦って
それで勝ったとしても。
text.official_en: Sure, the Sworn Six have the determination to sacrifice everything to achieve their goals. But I’ll be damned if I have to stoop to their level.
text.real_en: Abandoning everything... Sacrificing everything... Even if we fought with the same resolve as them and won...

text.jp: 俺たちと一緒にいれば退屈はしないぜ。
text.official_en: Yep, you’ll never be bored when you’re traveling with us, I guarantee it.

text.jp: 俺のしたことは自己満足だって言いたいのか？
text.official_en: Are you saying I’ve been shortsighted?
text.real_en: Are you saying I only helped them to satisfy myself?

text.jp: 俺はそうやって救った世界を好きになれないと思う。
text.official_en: I wouldn’t want to live in a world I had to save that way.
text.real_en: I don't think I could love a world I saved that way.

text.jp:
助かりました！
ありがとうございます。
text.official_en: Oh, thank goodness. Thank you ever so much!

text.jp: 古城？
text.official_en: Why head there?
text.real_en: An old castle?

text.jp:
天風の正体はドワーフに
飛空艇を伝えてくれたシドだったし
劫火も悪い奴じゃなかった気がする。
text.official_en: Aether revealed himself to be Cid—the man who introduced the dwarves to airships. Ignis seemed a decent enough man, too.
text.real_en: Heavenly Wind Veritas turned out to be Cid, the one who taught the dwarves about airships. And I don't think Inferno Veritas was such a bad guy either.

text.jp:
確かにお主といたら
ハラハラドキドキしっぱなしになるかものう。
まあ、退屈はしなさそうじゃ。
text.official_en: Hm. ’Twill make for an entertaining journey, at the very least.
text.real_en: With you, I'm sure every moment would keep me on my toes. At least I wouldn't be bored.

text.jp: 覚悟と信念か……。
text.official_en: “Conviction and resolve,” huh.

text.jp: 雪原に現れた魔物も退治しておいたぜ。
text.official_en: We’ve also taken care of the monster that was prowling the snowfields.

text.jp: （この世界を救うのは、こういう者なのかもしれん）
text.official_en: (Yet men like him may be the very thing this world needs.)
text.real_en: (Maybe someone like him can save this world.)

text.jp:
（こやつになら、
お前のことを話してもよさそうじゃ……）
text.official_en: (Perhaps the time has come for him to learn more about you...)
text.real_en: (I think I can tell him about you...)

text.jp: （はじめはどうなることかと思ったが……）
text.official_en: (At first, I had my doubts...)

text.jp: （サクラになんて答えようか……。）
text.official_en: (How should I respond to Sakura?)

text.jp:
（レーゲン……。
お前の息子は合格じゃよ）
text.official_en: (Raegen... Your son has passed my little test.)
